verdict.rationale: Khoj explicitly supports creating multiple agents each with custom knowledge, persona/system prompt, chat model, and tools (khoj-gh-1, khoj-docs-12, khoj-docs-26), letting users set up distinct agents like Writer, Researcher, Therapist for different use-cases and select which to converse with. This covers the core of running multiple distinct agents with their own prompts/models/workspaces. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic routing of conversations/channels to specific agents (vs. manual selection), and independent/hands-on corroboration of multi-agent workflows beyond first-party docs.
